Tree Entry

  • CURIE: gmeow:TreeEntry
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/TreeEntry
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/software

A named pointer within a source tree — a file or directory entry carrying a name, a file mode, and a reference to a Blob or SourceTree. Corresponds to a single line in a git tree object. Not content-addressed on its own; it acquires identity only as part of the tree that contains it.

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:InformationObject

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:TreeEntry as a specialized kind of gmeow:InformationObject. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:InformationObject
